description: Allow others to challenge you in order to explore new levels of yourself #selflove #selfmastery #leadershipskills
transcript: And I stopped taking things personal and began allowing others to be a mirror image of my internal world. I unlocked new levels. I started seeing different things within me and not everything I loved, but that allowed me the capacity to remove judgment and nourish myself. Do better, get better, become the most full version of me.
